components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored in E.164 form; a leading
            '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed
            and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+()\-\s]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Write-only create directive. When true, permits creating this owner even
            though another owner already has the same lastName and address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace); otherwise such a request is rejected.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            householdId:

All green. Here's a summary of the change.

## What changed

The effective registration date (supplied in the request or defaulted to the server date) must now land on a business day: a Saturday or Sunday rolls forward to the next Monday, and every value derived from the date uses the adjusted value.

**New — `BusinessDays.java`** (shared helper in the create-owner function package): `adjust(LocalDate)` rolls Saturday → +2 days and Sunday → +1 day to reach Monday; weekdays are returned unchanged and the transform is idempotent. One place defines the rule so all derived values agree.

**`DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate.java`** — previously only filled in the server date when the field was absent and left supplied dates untouched. Now it resolves the effective date (supplied value, or `LocalDate.now()` when absent) and stores `BusinessDays.adjust(...)` of it. Because this step runs before `AssignMembershipNumber`, the membership number's `YY` year segment automatically uses the adjusted date — no change needed there.

**`EnsureDailyOwnerLimit.java`** — previously counted owners whose `registrationDate` equalled the raw `LocalDate.now()`. Since owners are now stored with the adjusted date, that would never match on a weekend. It now takes the validated `@Val OwnerFieldsDto`, computes the request's own effective adjusted business day (the same way `DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate` will), and counts existing owners in that business-day bucket — so the 100/day limit counts per adjusted business day.

**`openapi.yml`** — updated the `registrationDate` description to document the weekend-roll behaviour.

- Full suite: **31 tests, 0 failures, BUILD SUCCESS.**
- The four tests for this spec pass: Cp07 (weekend supplied date rolls to Monday, weekday kept), Cp14 (membership `YY` uses the adjusted date), Cp19 (daily limit per adjusted business day — 100 then 101st rejected), Cp20 (default date is never a weekend).

Note: the test base defines a `toBusinessDay` helper that also skips public holidays, but no test exercises holidays and the given spec covers only weekends, so I implemented weekend rolling exactly as specified. If holiday-skipping is wanted later, `BusinessDays.adjust` is the single place to extend.
